subject.title: feat: allow standalone MCP Apps to use bound tools and resources

question: Should ticketed standalone MCP App views be allowed to invoke only their owning server’s app-visible tools and resources under this PR’s ticket/origin/lease revalidation model?
rationale: This is an intentional expansion of authority for a browser-hosted standalone surface; code review can assess implementation quality, but maintainers must choose whether that authority model is acceptable product and security policy.

options.title: Approve bounded bridge
options.body: Accept the limited standalone authority model after a maintainer confirms the ticket, origin, lease, visibility, and read-only reconstruction constraints.

options.title: Keep standalone views read-only
options.body: Reject interactive standalone operations and retain the existing read-only ticket host until a different product boundary is approved.

options.title: Narrow the allowed operations
options.body: Permit only a smaller subset, such as resource reads, and require the branch to encode that narrower contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded bridge
recommendation.body: Accept the limited standalone authority model after a maintainer confirms the ticket, origin, lease, visibility, and read-only reconstruction constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposal and can clarify the intended threat model, while another maintainer should make the final policy decision.
